rules.statement: Serial frames use 8N1: one start bit (0), eight data bits LSB first, no parity, one stop bit (1).

rules.condition: When the serial line is idle
rules.statement: The serial line is held high when idle.
Each bit period lasts PARA_UART_CLKS_PER_BIT i_clk cycles.
PARA_UART_CLKS_PER_BIT is fixed at elaboration and must be within the legal range 4 to 65535.
The transmit byte stream uses a valid/ready handshake on i_tx_valid, o_tx_ready and i_tx_data.
The only transmit storage is the shift register, with no additional transmit buffering.

rules.condition: When bytes are sent back to back
rules.statement: No idle bit is inserted between the stop bit and the next start bit.
The receive byte stream uses a valid/ready handshake on o_rx_valid, i_rx_ready, o_rx_data and o_rx_frame_err.
A one-byte holding register keeps each received byte until it is taken.
The asynchronous input i_rxd passes through a two-flip-flop synchronizer.
The receiver detects a start bit on a falling edge and rechecks the start bit in the middle of the bit, rejecting glitches.
The receiver samples each data bit and the stop bit in the middle of the bit.

rules.condition: When the stop bit is sampled as 0
rules.statement: o_rx_frame_err is set and delivered together with the received byte.

rules.condition: When a received byte is dropped because the previous byte has not been taken

rules.statement: The transmitter and receiver operate simultaneously and independently of each other (full duplex).
The synchronizer must be present by structure; its metastability behaviour is not checked in simulation.
